about: B6 (HAL-2612, HAL-3747): on Windows the CLI (Node's realpath) and the shell (canonicalize, then plain_path) must key a folder alike, whatever case or 8.3 short name it was given in. Each case names a folder under a fresh root that holds only the folders below; key is the folder's location relative to the root's own key. In a fresh folder Windows gives the first long name starting with HALONI the short name HALONI~1, and so on. Checked by tests/windows_folder_keys.rs (the shell) and tests/windows-folder-keys.mjs (the CLI's realpath) in the tauri-windows CI job, on a volume with 8.3 names on.

cases.name: 8.3 short name below a long one
